title: Knowledge of cultural moral norms in large language models
findings: The paper cites prior work showing GPT-3's bias against Muslims. Its own findings indicate that English language models misrepresent moral norms in non-western/non-rich countries on various topics, including 'terrorism as a political, ideological or religious mean'. The models' assessments of such topics are often encoded as more morally appropriate in these countries than the empirical data suggests. The authors also note their methodology may overlook significant diversity in religious beliefs within cultural groups.
